observations.source: use fsr_sdk::upscaler::{Dimensions,UpscaleDispatch}; fn frame(f: &mut UpscaleDispatch<'_>) { f.set_active_render_size(Some(Dimensions::new(256,144).unwrap())); let _: Option<Dimensions>=f.active_render_size(); f.set_active_render_size(None); } fn main() {}

use fsr_sdk::upscaler::{ID3D12Resource,UpscaleResources}; fn resources(r: [&ID3D12Resource;4]) -> UpscaleResources<'_> { let b=UpscaleResources::without_exposure(r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3]); assert!(b.exposure().is_none()); b.clone() } fn main() {}

use fsr_sdk::upscaler::{ColorEncodingHint,UpscaleDispatch}; fn configure(f: &mut UpscaleDispatch<'_>) { f.set_color_encoding_hint(ColorEncodingHint::Srgb); let _: ColorEncodingHint=f.color_encoding_hint(); f.set_color_encoding_hint_allow_context_mismatch(ColorEncodingHint::Pq); assert!(f.allows_color_encoding_context_mismatch()); f.set_color_encoding_hint(ColorEncodingHint::Pq); assert!(!f.allows_color_encoding_context_mismatch()); } fn main() {}

use fsr_sdk::upscaler::{ColorEncodingHint, InputColorSpace, Dimensions, UpscalerOptions, common}; fn main() { let d=Dimensions::new(320,180).unwrap(); let mut o=UpscalerOptions::new(d,d); assert_eq!(o.input_color_space(), InputColorSpace::Linear); o.set_input_color_space(InputColorSpace::NonLinear); let _: common::InputColorSpace=o.input_color_space(); let _: common::ColorEncodingHint=ColorEncodingHint::default(); for hint in [ColorEncodingHint::Unspecified, ColorEncodingHint::Srgb, ColorEncodingHint::Pq] { match hint { ColorEncodingHint::Unspecified | ColorEncodingHint::Srgb | ColorEncodingHint::Pq => {}, _ => {} } } }

use fsr_sdk::upscaler::{CameraParameters, DepthConvention, MotionVectorUnits, MotionVectorResolution, MotionVectorJitter, Dimensions, UpscalerOptions, common}; fn main() { let d = Dimensions::new(320, 180).unwrap(); let mut options = UpscalerOptions::new(d, d); for depth in [DepthConvention::StandardFinite, DepthConvention::ReversedFinite, DepthConvention::StandardInfinite, DepthConvention::ReversedInfinite] { options.set_depth_convention(depth); let _: common::DepthConvention = options.depth_convention(); let _ = depth.is_infinite(); } options.set_motion_vector_resolution(MotionVectorResolution::Display); let _: common::MotionVectorResolution = options.motion_vector_resolution(); options.set_motion_vector_jitter(MotionVectorJitter::Included); let _: common::MotionVectorJitter = options.motion_vector_jitter(); let _: common::MotionVectorUnits = MotionVectorUnits::Pixels; let camera = CameraParameters::new_infinite(0.1, 1.0, 1.0).unwrap(); assert!(camera.has_infinite_far_plane()); match options.depth_convention() { DepthConvention::StandardFinite | DepthConvention::ReversedFinite | DepthConvention::StandardInfinite | DepthConvention::ReversedInfinite => {}, _ => {} } }

use fsr_sdk::{runtime::Runtime, upscaler::{Upscaler, ID3D12Device, UpscalerOptions}, query::{ProviderInfo, GpuMemoryUsage, ResourceRequirements, QualityMode, JitterPhaseCount}, error::Error}; fn inspect(r: &mut Runtime, u: &mut Upscaler, d: &ID3D12Device, o: &UpscalerOptions) -> Result<(), Error> { let _: Vec<ProviderInfo> = r.upscaler_providers_dx12(d)?; let _: GpuMemoryUsage = r.estimate_upscaler_memory_dx12(d, o)?; let _: ProviderInfo = u.provider()?; let _: ResourceRequirements = u.resource_requirements()?; let _: GpuMemoryUsage = u.gpu_memory_usage()?; let display=o.max_upscale_size(); let render=o.max_render_size(); let _: f32=r.upscaler_ratio_dx12(d, QualityMode::Balanced)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::Dimensions=r.upscaler_render_size_dx12(d, display, QualityMode::Balanced)?; let phase: JitterPhaseCount=r.upscaler_jitter_phase_count_dx12(d, render, display)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::JitterOffsetPixels=r.upscaler_jitter_offset_dx12(d, 0, phase)?; let _: f32=u.upscale_ratio(QualityMode::Balanced)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::Dimensions=u.render_size(display, QualityMode::Balanced)?; let phase: JitterPhaseCount=u.jitter_phase_count(render, display)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::JitterOffsetPixels=u.jitter_offset(0, phase)?; Ok(()) } fn main() {}

use fsr_sdk::{runtime::MovableRuntime, upscaler::{MovableUpscaler, ID3D12Device, UpscalerOptions}, query::{ProviderInfo, GpuMemoryUsage, ResourceRequirements, QualityMode, JitterPhaseCount}, error::Error}; fn inspect(r: &mut MovableRuntime, u: &mut MovableUpscaler, d: &ID3D12Device, o: &UpscalerOptions) -> Result<(), Error> { let _: Vec<ProviderInfo> = r.upscaler_providers_dx12(d)?; let _: GpuMemoryUsage = r.estimate_upscaler_memory_dx12(d, o)?; let _: ProviderInfo = u.provider()?; let _: ResourceRequirements = u.resource_requirements()?; let _: GpuMemoryUsage = u.gpu_memory_usage()?; let display=o.max_upscale_size(); let render=o.max_render_size(); let _: f32=r.upscaler_ratio_dx12(d, QualityMode::Balanced)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::Dimensions=r.upscaler_render_size_dx12(d, display, QualityMode::Balanced)?; let phase: JitterPhaseCount=r.upscaler_jitter_phase_count_dx12(d, render, display)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::JitterOffsetPixels=r.upscaler_jitter_offset_dx12(d, 0, phase)?; let _: f32=u.upscale_ratio(QualityMode::Balanced)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::Dimensions=u.render_size(display, QualityMode::Balanced)?; let phase: JitterPhaseCount=u.jitter_phase_count(render, display)?; let _: fsr_sdk::upscaler::JitterOffsetPixels=u.jitter_offset(0, phase)?; Ok(()) } fn main() {}
